title: performance canary: automated regression detection and rollout guards
author: Ava Martinez
description: Add adaptive automated regression detection to the performance canary pipeline and wire it into rollout guards so canary rollouts fail fast on latency/throughput regressions. Motivation: recent incidents showed we lacked automated, workload-aware thresholds causing regressions to reach production. This PR implements: 1) a new detector service that compares baseline and canary percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and throughput over sliding windows, using relative delta and absolute caps; 2) adaptive thresholds that use baseline variance to pick sensitivity (low variance -> tighter thresholds); 3) hysteresis and cooldown windows to avoid flapping; 4) KV cache-aware checks that exclude cold-start spikes and account for cache-hit rate; 5) integration with the existing rollout-guard API to block or auto-roll back canaries when sustained regression is detected; 6) dashboards and alerting: adds perf-canary dashboard and incident runbook links; 7) unit and integration tests (local harness + canary sim). Implementation notes: Detector runs as part of perf-canary pipeline every 30s by default, computes relative increases for p95 and throughput over 5m and 30m windows, marks a regression if p95 increases by >10% AND throughput drops >8% sustained for 5m, or if p99 increases >15% absolute. Hysteresis: requires 2 consecutive detection windows (60s) to trigger guard; post-trigger cooldown is 10m. Config is fully dynamic via services/perf-canary/config.yaml and feature flag. Rollout behavior: when detector signals regression, the rollout-guard API marks canary unhealthy and triggers automatic rollback for automated rollouts, or blocks manual promotion for manual rollouts. Testing: included simulated workloads in tests/perf_canary_integ.test, CI runs the perf harness (canary-sim) and devs verified on staging deploy. Checklist: - [x] Detector implementation and config - [x] Hysteresis and cooldown - [x] KV cache adjustments - [x] Rollout-guard integration - [x] Dashboard + runbook - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Documentation updates (docs/perf-canary.md) Rollout plan: feature gated behind ff/perf_canary_auto_detect, opt-in by default on staging, enable for low-traffic customers for 2 weeks, then ramp. Metrics to watch: p95 latency delta, throughput delta, cache-hit rate, false-positive rate. Backwards compatibility: config defaults preserve previous behavior; operators can disable detector via config. References: ENG-3245 for detection design, postmortem SUP-1123.
commits: detector: add regression detector core loop and windowing logic
config: add adaptive thresholds and feature flag
integration: wire detector into rollout guard API and add unit tests
monitoring: add perf-canary dashboard and runbook link
tests: add canary-sim integration test harness
review_comments: Liam Chen (reviewer): Please clarify why both p95 and throughput are required to trigger. Author: using both reduces noise from transient latency spikes; throughput change protects against capacity regressions.
Priya Rao (reviewer): Tests flake on CI when running on low-CPU builders. Author: added synthetic workload generator and relaxed timing in CI; reran tests.
Noah Kim (approver): Minor nit on config naming, prefer 'sensitivity' over 'sensitivity_level' - updated.
release_notes: Adds automated performance regression detection for canaries with rollout guard integration. Configurable thresholds and hysteresis. Opt-in feature flag. Improve canary safety and reduce manual rollback time.
